title: Normalized inverse-image endpoints and one-trace comparison
statement: For the coefficient module categories of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category], a scheme map $f:X\to S$, modules $M,N$ and a prescribed map $f^{-1}M\to N$ of underlying abelian sheaves, a pullback endpoint is an isomorphism $f^*M\simeq N$ whose module-adjoint has exactly the ordinary sheaf-adjoint of that prescribed map as its underlying arrow. Its derived and shifted arrows use the canonical exact inverse-image single comparison and its shift structure. For a commutative square and two universally normalized right-derived models with specified equalities to the actual right-derived functors, conjugate the canonical derived exchange of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-exchange] by those equalities. A trace-pullback property for a specified line, line endpoint, coefficient-unit endpoint and two traces means this exchange is invertible on the shifted positive line and that the square of the two traces commutes using precisely those endpoints and that exchange.
